title: Bias at the End of the Score

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring changes in hypersexualization (via NSFW classification rate and skin exposure metrics) during reward-guided noise optimization, and analyzing reward scoring disparities on counterfactual image datasets varying by gender using linear regression and rank-based evaluation, including comparisons with real-world occupational gender statistics.

Tracking demographic convergence by measuring shifts in perceived race during reward-guided image optimization (using CLIP embeddings mapped to real-world face dataset anchors), and evaluating scoring disparities across counterfactual image sets varying by race using linear regression and ranking analyses.
